# ORGAN — the organ's own book

<!-- GENERATED by tools/organ_ledger.py from src/console/organ_params.inc
     and src/console/organ_registry.hpp — do not hand-edit.
     Regenerate: python3 tools/organ_ledger.py -->

The audit family's fifth member. BINDING, COMMAND, MANIFEST and MIRROR
each keep a book about one of the program's rooms; this is the panel's.

**A coupling is a parameter set into trajectory over time**, so every
row below with an authored range is a TRAJECTORY DOMAIN. This table is
the music campaign's target map, not panel decoration: the range column
is the domain a trajectory would play over, and the cadence column says
whether playing it would be heard now, at the frame boundary, or at the
author's next natural event.

Cadence is DERIVED, never stored — the rule lives once in
`organ_registry.hpp::derived_cadence()` and is restated once in this
generator, so the book and the manifest cannot disagree. `driven` is an
`_RO` witness: the panel meters it and `organ_set` refuses to write it.
